title: US employers who have trialed a four-day workweek, 2022 vs 2024

source.name: Four-day workweek employer adoption surveys
source.publisher: 4 Day Week Global / industry HR surveys

notes: Share of employers reporting they had trialed some form of a four-day workweek rose from about 14% in 2022 to about 22% in 2024, per employer-survey tracking cited across 2024-2025 four-day-week coverage.
